description: Nearest reference drugs to a SMILES (Tanimoto, Morgan radius 2), each with measured human plasma CL and the CL IVIVE predicted from its measured inputs. Use it to judge how far to trust calc_clhep for this chemotype: if IVIVE missed on the neighbours, expect it to miss here. Returns neighbours only, not a prediction for the query.
